name: astra
description: ASTRA 방법론 플러그인. Sprint 0 프로젝트 초기화, 코딩 컨벤션 자동 적용 (Java/TypeScript/React Native/Python/CSS/SCSS), 공공 데이터 표준 적용, 국제 표준 코드 (ISO 3166-1/2, ITU-T E.164), 네이밍 검증, 품질 게이트, Slack 연동, 서비스 매뉴얼 자동 생성, UX/UI/Dev/QA Screen ID 기반 Handoff 패키지 자동 생성(HANDOFF_PROCESS_GUIDE v1.1), 역할 기반 페르소나 에이전트(기획자/디자이너/개발자/테스터 검증·위임), /autorun 자가 개선 파이프라인(기획→테스트 자동 실행 + 최대 N회 반복 자가 개선 루프, 테스트 통과 시 조기 종료)을 제공합니다. v5.1.0: /blueprint 전용 스킬 추가 — 데이터 플로우·스키마·API 계약·시퀀스·의사코드 로직에 집중한 10개 표준 섹션 청사진 (실행 코드 제외). Section 10 'HITL Triggers'가 /feature-dev의 구현 단계 HITL 발동을 가드합니다. /sprint-init prompt-map Step 1.1과 /autorun Stage 3가 새 스킬로 위임됩니다. v4.0.0: /ux-publish 제거, HTML 기획화면 생성은 /service-planner Step 6에 통합.

plugins.name: astra-methodology
plugins.description: ASTRA methodology plugin with coding convention enforcement, data standard, international code standards, naming validation, quality gates, Slack integration, service manual auto-generator, UX/UI/Dev/QA Screen-ID based handoff package generator, role-based persona agents, and /autorun self-improving full pipeline. v5.1.0 NEW: /blueprint dedicated skill — 10 standard sections focused on data flow, schema DDL, API contract, sequence diagrams, pseudocode logic (no implementation code), plus a Section 10 'HITL Triggers' that /feature-dev consults during implementation to ask the user only on critical decisions (business decisions without a clear blueprint answer, security/permission choices, external dependency introduction, destructive changes). /sprint-init prompt-map Step 1.1 and /autorun Stage 3 now delegate to this skill. Single source of truth: the blueprint itself gates HITL — no external hook needed. v5.0.0 BREAKING: Sprint-level worktree model. /sprint-init creates `.astra-worktrees/sprint-<N>-<name>/` with sprint branch and port-isolated `.astra-worktree.env`; all dev + test happen inside the worktree. /test-run no longer touches dev — it sources the env, launches on the sprint port, and guarantees port release via 4-step cleanup. /pr-merge runs from the worktree, merges to dev, then auto-removes the worktree. REMOVED: /pr-merge --start mode; main-worktree guards on /test-run and /test-scenario; /test-run dev-commit + dev→staging promotion (moved to /pr-merge). v4.0.0 BREAKING: /ux-publish removed; HTML mockup generation integrated into /service-planner Step 6.
